notes_for_editor: Build and gone dates, and the 10-foot height, come only from firelookout.com. The 10-foot figure is unusually short for an L-4 cab; check it before using it as a height. The story attributes it to the guide's description and does not present it as independently confirmed. The FFLA and Lincoln County lists confirm location and gone status only. The Lincoln County list gives a township-range-section code, 35N-32W-30, which was not converted to a place. The photo credited to the Fire Lookout Museum on firelookout.com has no license given, so no photo was added. Web searches found no other source. Record coordinates match the FFLA list exactly.
